item.title: Agentic ECU Testing: From CAN Signals to Autonomous Test Execution
item.description: A look at the decode layer underneath CAN test automation — why DBC-based signal decode, not raw frames, is what makes ECU test automation and autonomous execution trustworthy.

item.title: How to read a monthly benchmark release
item.description: A guide to reading agentic test and validation results through task acceptance, evidence, cost, time, and reliability.

item.title: Agentic Testing for ROS 2 & DDS Systems
item.description: A walkthrough of how an AI agent runs ROS2 test automation end to end — discovering the DDS graph, commanding and gating on telemetry, recording multi-topic evidence, and producing a verdict.

item.title: How AI agents can control real test benches with MCP
item.description: Why MCP hardware test automation works where raw shell access doesn't — a narrow, typed, authorized set of operations is what makes AI agent hardware control safe to approve.

item.title: AI Agents vs. Traditional Test Automation: What Should Actually Be Autonomous?
item.description: A framework for AI test automation that scopes autonomous testing by how bounded and reviewable an action is, not by how capable the underlying model happens to be.

item.title: AI Hardware-in-the-Loop Testing: Giving AI Agents Access to Real Hardware
item.description: Why most HIL rigs keep AI agents out entirely, and what a bounded-access architecture for AI HIL testing looks like once hardware in the loop and AI hardware testing stop being a trust exercise.

item.title: Automating CAN-based ECU tests with AI agents
item.description: Why a CAN or ECU test procedure is a lifecycle, not a single frame send, and how an agent-driven workflow keeps that lifecycle bounded and reviewable.

item.title: From Manual Test Benches to Unattended Testing: Building a 24/7 Hardware Test Lab
item.description: A practical look at what it takes to turn a manual test bench into an automated test bench that supports unattended testing and remote hardware testing around the clock.

item.title: Running unattended ROS 2 hardware tests
item.description: Why most ROS 2 hardware testing is bottlenecked on a terminal and a person watching it, and what it takes to make a DDS-based test run unattended.

item.title: Why test automation still requires an engineer in the loop
item.description: Automation that stops at "run the script" still needs a person standing next to it — a look at where test automation actually breaks down and what closes the gap.

item.title: What Is Agentic Test & Development? From Test Scripts to Autonomous Engineering
item.description: What "agentic testing" actually means, and how agentic test automation differs from a fixed test script by deciding its next bounded action instead of replaying a fixed one.
